decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the LED supply to 3.3V, disables the level shifter, establishes direct ESP32 drive, and removes the obsolete level-shifter part.
Removing this level-shifter part from the BOM does not change the general component sourceability and cost policies.
The LED supply and level-shifter decision does not alter the requirement to review assembly settings, fees, or assist with ordering.
The source decision does not affect KiCad project portability or library resolution.
The board role, LED count, selected SK6812 model, package, part number, and color format remain unchanged; supply and data logic are owned by a separate Requirement.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the LEDs from the 5V rail's powered loads and narrows the rail context to sensor power.

Moving the LEDs to 3.3V does not necessarily remove or change the independently specified behavior of cutting LED power when unused; the source does not establish a new switching GPIO or architecture.
The existing same-message MODIFY already adds the addressable LEDs to the 3.3V measurement coverage while leaving both monitored rails intact.
The requirement already specifies powering the full shared 3.3V rail; the source does not establish a change to the standalone regulator, rating, activation condition, or source-selection behavior.
The LED power and logic change does not affect USB-C enumeration or programming behavior.
The AXP2101 battery and USB power-path topology remains valid; the source only changes which rail powers the LEDs.
Direct ESP32 data drive does not establish a new GPIO assignment or change the recorded module GPIO compatibility constraints.
